question: Which bodily and perceptual attainments result from this yogic accomplishment?
premises: Destruction of wrinkles and grey hair is named.
Seeing from very far away is named.
Both are presented as attained results.
inference: The accomplishment removes signs of aging and grants vision from a great distance.
plain_english: One gains the destruction of wrinkles and grey hair, and likewise the power to see from very far away.
